description: An organization is several months away from an audit and wants to know what evidence should be collected gradually now so the review does not become a last-minute scramble.

user_profile.persona: 45-year-old operations and compliance lead trying to make audit preparation more sustainable
user_profile.context: Past audits technically passed, but only after exhausting bursts of reactive evidence gathering
user_profile.communication_style: Preventive and process-minded, prefers steady preparation over heroics

fact_sheet.fact: Stellar Innovations Inc. is preparing for a SOC 2 Type 2 audit for its 'Nexus Platform' product.
The audit is being conducted by the firm Veritas Assurance Partners, with Maria Chen as the lead auditor.
The official audit observation period is from January 1, 2024, to June 30, 2024.
The on-site portion of the audit is scheduled to begin on August 5, 2024.
The Q1 2024 user access review for the AWS production environment (Account ID: 9876-5432-1098) is due by March 31, 2024.
Alex Vega, Compliance Lead, tracks all evidence collection tasks in the Vanta platform, accessible at https://stellar.vanta.com.
All administrative access to production systems requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) managed through Duo Security.
A new developer, Sam Jones, was granted read-only access to the 'staging-db-replica' on March 11, 2024, as approved in Jira ticket ENG-1138.

All standard code changes deployed to production must have an approved Jira ticket, a successful build in the CircleCI pipeline 'prod-deploy-v2', and documented Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval; emergency changes must be documented in an incident report.
Pull Request #729 in the 'webapp-backend' GitHub repository was approved by lead engineer Ben Carter on March 14, 2024 at 2:15 PM PST.
The Change Advisory Board (CAB) meeting occurs every Tuesday at 10:00 AM PST via the Google Meet link meet.google.com/cab-stellar-weekly.
The last emergency change, documented in incident report SIR-2024-005, was deployed on February 20, 2024, to patch a critical vulnerability (CVE-2024-12345).
Stellar Innovations uses Datadog for infrastructure monitoring and security alerting, with logs retained for 12 months.
A high-severity security alert (ID: DD-ALERT-98172) for unusual login activity was triggered on March 12, 2024, at 11:45 PM UTC and was resolved by on-call engineer Priya Sharma.
The annual penetration test by CyberDefend Solutions is scheduled for the week of May 13, 2024; the SOW is document #CDS-SI-2024-01.
All company-issued laptops are required to have CrowdStrike Falcon sensor version 7.04 or higher installed and active.
The most recent weekly AWS Inspector vulnerability scan from March 13, 2024, identified two medium-severity findings, tracked in tickets SEC-901 and SEC-902.
All new hires must complete the 'Stellar Innovations Security Awareness Training 2024' course in KnowBe4 within 7 days of their start date.
New hire Chloe Davis (start date March 4, 2024) completed her security training on March 6, 2024; the certificate is stored in her Rippling HR profile.
As per policy CM-POL-007, all system access for a departing employee must be revoked within 2 hours of their official termination time.
The last departing employee, Mark Robinson, was offboarded on February 28, 2024; the offboarding ticket HR-089 was closed at 4:30 PM PST that day.
A new sub-processor, 'DataPipe Analytics', was onboarded on February 15, 2024, to process marketing data.
The security review for 'DataPipe Analytics,' including their SOC 2 Type 2 report, was approved by Alex Vega on February 12, 2024, and is stored in Confluence page ID 554321.
The annual security review of critical vendor AWS is scheduled for June 10, 2024.
All production RDS databases are encrypted at rest using the AWS KMS key with ARN 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-g1h2-i3j4k5l6m7n8'.
Production database backups are taken daily at 02:00 AM UTC and retained for 35 days, as configured in AWS Backup plan 'prod-db-backup-plan-01'.
The company's Data Classification Policy (version 2.1, dated January 5, 2024) defines three levels of data: Public, Internal, and Confidential.
The 'Production DB Admins' Okta group, which grants privileged database access, currently has 4 members: Ben Carter, Priya Sharma, Li Wei, and David Chen.

user_needs.description: What is the product being audited, what is the audit framework, and what is the official observation period?
Who is the lead auditor and when does the on-site audit begin?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up to get more details about the audit personnel and key dates.

user_needs.description: What is the deadline for the Q1 2024 user access review for the AWS production environment?
What are the details of a recent developer access grant, including who was granted access, to what resource, and the approval ticket?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After identifying the current members of the privileged 'Production DB Admins' group, the user will naturally ask for a concrete recent access-grant example to collect as supporting evidence.

user_needs.description: Who are the current members of the 'Production DB Admins' Okta group?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the user access review deadline, the user will naturally want a current privileged-access population to review, such as the 'Production DB Admins' group.

user_needs.description: Which AWS KMS key is used to encrypt production RDS databases?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing who has privileged access to production databases, a natural security follow-up is to verify how that data is protected at rest.

user_needs.description: What evidence is required for a code change to be deployed to production, and what document is used for an emergency change?
Provide an example of a recent, approved pull request, including the repo, approver, and timestamp.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the audit lead and key on-site date, the user will want to begin collecting concrete sample evidence early; a recent approved production pull request is a natural change-management artifact to gather.

user_needs.description: What is the security awareness training requirement for new hires?
Provide the details for a recent new hire's training completion, including their name, start date, and completion date.
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After asking about the onboarding policy, the user needs a specific example of a new hire who completed the training.

user_needs.description: What are the details of the most recent employee offboarding, including their name, date, and the ticket closure time?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Discussing onboarding evidence naturally leads to gathering evidence for the other end of the employee lifecycle: offboarding.

user_needs.description: Describe a recent high-severity security alert, including its ID, the nature of the alert, and who resolved it.
What were the findings from the most recent weekly AWS Inspector vulnerability scan and how are they being tracked?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing a reactive security event (an alert), the user may want to see evidence of proactive security work, like vulnerability scanning.

user_needs.description: What new sub-processor was recently onboarded and for what purpose?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After clarifying the audit timeline and lead auditor, the user will naturally identify additional evidence domains to collect early, including recent sub-processor onboarding.

user_needs.description: Where is the security review documentation for 'DataPipe Analytics' stored and who approved it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After identifying a new vendor, the user needs to find the associated due diligence evidence.
